title: Perfect!
text: Perfect!. This is just perfect. I love folding clothes techniques but this just makes it easier for when I have no time to do it myself. It's very fast and they look as if they were at the store/ for view. The only thing , I did not like the quality of the folding parts too much, also you must fold it a certain way to store it. But other than that the clothes fold ultra fast and definitely saves a long time if you don't have much. :) I got this on discount price on cybermonday deals.
